home.intro: mailnix watches your mailboxes and sorts incoming mail with rules you build visually – with a preview of what each rule would do before it touches anything.
home.nextSteps: Next: create rules for your mailboxes. You are signed in as {role}.

notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Mailboxes mailnix watches and sorts.
accounts.emptyHint: Connect a mailbox to start sorting mail with rules.
accounts.deleteText: mailnix stops processing this mailbox. Messages on the server are not touched.

provider.ImapDescription: Any mail server with IMAP and a password.

fields.name: Account name

folders.watchedHint: Rules run on new mail in these folders.
folders.specialHint: Where "delete", "mark as spam" and "archive" put messages. Detected automatically.

safety.title: Safety
safety.blastRadiusHint: Runs that would move or delete more messages than this pause and ask you first.
safety.purgeTrashHint: Permanently delete messages that have been in the trash for a while. Counted from when mailnix first sees them there. Off by default.

lists.title: Named lists
lists.subtitle: Reusable lists of addresses, domains or patterns for your rules, e.g. VIPs or blocked senders.

lists.usedBy: used by {count} rule | used by {count} rules

lists.kindFixed: The type cannot be changed later.

lists.inUse: This list is used by rules and cannot be deleted:

lists.importReplace: Replace all entries with the file
lists.importInvalid: {count} line could not be imported: | {count} lines could not be imported:

rules.title: Rules
rules.subtitle: Rules run from top to bottom. The first rule that moves a message wins; flags and keywords of all matching rules apply.
rules.noAccounts: Add a mail account first to create rules.
rules.empty: No rules for this account yet
rules.emptyHint: Start from a template or build a rule from scratch.
rules.deleteText: The rule stops running. Messages are not affected.
rules.inUse: This rule is used by other rules and cannot be deleted: {rules}
rules.usedBy: used by {count} rule | used by {count} rules

triggers.OnNewHint: Runs on new messages in the source folders.
triggers.ScheduledHint: Runs regularly over existing messages, e.g. for cleanups.
triggers.ManualHint: Runs only when you start it.

editor.name: Name
editor.scheduleHint: Cron expression (minute hour day month weekday), in UTC.
editor.sourceFoldersHint: Leave empty to use the account's watched folders.
editor.enabledHint: Inactive rules run no actions but can still be used as a filter by other rules.
editor.dryRunHint: Only log what the rule would do, without changing messages.
editor.stopProcessingHint: When this rule matches, later rules are not evaluated.
editor.actionsHint: Without actions, the rule only serves as a filter for other rules.
editor.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

fields.Subject: Subject
fields.IsReplyToMyMail: Reply to a mail I sent

actions.oneTerminal: A rule can move a message only once.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: Try the rule on the newest messages of a folder. Nothing is changed on the server.
preview.invalid: Complete the rule to see a preview.
preview.threshold: In this sample alone, the rule would move more messages than the confirmation threshold ({threshold}). Such runs pause and ask first.
preview.limitReduced: Rules on the message text read at most {limit} messages.
preview.subject: Subject

skipReasons.SpecialFolderNotConfigured: no such folder configured for the account

notes.ReferenceDepthExceeded: rules reference each other too deeply

templates.title: Start from a template
templates.hint: Templates fill in the rule builder. Check the preview, adjust and save.

newsletters-to-folder.name: Newsletters into a folder
newsletters-to-folder.description: Moves newsletters and bulk mail out of the inbox.

newsletter-cleanup.name: Clean up old newsletters
newsletter-cleanup.description: Daily: archives newsletters older than a few days, marked as read.

archive-by-year.name: Archive by year
archive-by-year.description: Daily: moves unflagged messages older than a few months into a folder per year.

sort-by-sender-domain.name: Sort by sender domain
sort-by-sender-domain.description: Messages from domains in a list go into one folder per domain.

auto-replies.name: Auto-replies out of the way
auto-replies.description: Out-of-office and other automatic replies go into their own folder, marked as read.

shops-by-plus-tag.name: Shops by plus tag
shops-by-plus-tag.description: Mail to me+shopname{'@'}… goes into one folder per tag.

quarantine-failed-dmarc.name: Quarantine suspicious senders
quarantine-failed-dmarc.description: Mail failing DMARC or with a spoofed display name goes to spam.

large-attachments.name: Flag large attachments
large-attachments.description: Flags messages with big attachments and tags them.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: What mailnix did in your mailboxes. Runs can be undone.
activity.emptyHint: Runs appear here when rules act on new mail or when you run them manually.
activity.undoText: mailnix moves the messages back, removes copies and restores flags. Messages that were changed or moved since cannot always be restored.
activity.awaitingToast: A run is waiting for your confirmation.
activity.reviewText: This run would move {count} messages, more than the confirmation threshold of the account. Check the list and confirm or cancel.
activity.notWaiting: This run is not waiting for confirmation.
activity.purgeCounts: {executed} of {examined} messages in Trash deleted permanently
activity.selectAll: Select all that can be undone
activity.undoSelectedText: Each message is put back as a whole: whatever its run did to it is undone, not only the selected action.

runNow.title: Run rules now
runNow.text: Applies the active rules to the newest messages of a folder that could match (the mail server preselects them). Large runs ask for confirmation first.
runNow.ruleText: Applies this rule to the newest messages of a folder that could match, even if it is switched off.

undoRule.title: Undo recent actions of "{name}"
undoRule.text: Reverts the most recent actions of this rule, newest first.

oauth.title: Signing in
oauth.explanation: You will be taken to {provider} to allow mailnix to read and organize your mail. mailnix never sees your {provider} password; it keeps a revocable permission, encrypted.
oauth.notConfiguredHint: Needs an OAuth app registered by whoever runs this server (see docs/oauth-setup.md).
oauth.invalidCallback: This page was opened without sign-in data.
oauth.added: Account added. Check its folders and settings.

dashboard.subtitle: Today in your mailboxes. Numbers update as mail comes in.

hints.NoRules: No rules yet. Start from a template, then check the preview before switching it on.
hints.NeverMatched: "{rule}" has not acted on anything in 30 days. Check its conditions in the preview.
hints.DryRunReady: "{rule}" would have acted {count} times in two weeks (dry run). Ready to switch dry run off?

dashboard.noAccounts: Add a mailbox to see what mailnix does in it.
dashboard.activityDescription: Click a day to see its actions.

stats.title: Stats
stats.subtitle: What arrives, what your rules do with it, and how reliably.
stats.volumeDescription: New mail compared with the actions rules took. Click a point for that period's actions.
stats.byActionDescription: Click a column for its actions.
stats.rulesDescription: Matched: messages a rule acted on in the period. Undone: actions reverted.
stats.sendersSummary: {total} new messages, {bulk} newsletters or bulk mail
stats.topActionedDescription: Messages a rule acted on, of all new messages from the domain.
stats.foldersDescription: Latest daily count; change since the start of the last 90 days.
stats.folderGrowthDescription: Messages in all folders, once a day.
stats.authFailuresDescription: New mail whose sender authentication failed (from the receiving server's Authentication-Results).
stats.neverMatchedYet: Has not acted on any mail yet.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: The people in your organization, who administers it, and invitations for new members.
team.mailboxes: No mailboxes connected | 1 mailbox connected | {count} mailboxes connected
team.membersHint: Organization admins manage this page. Everybody else only sees their own mailboxes and rules.
team.removeText: Their account is deleted. | Their account is deleted, together with their mailbox, its rules and history. Nothing in the mailbox itself changes. | Their account is deleted, together with their {count} mailboxes, their rules and history. Nothing in the mailboxes themselves changes.
team.invitationsHint: An invitation link is valid for 7 days and can be used once.
team.inviteEmailHint: Optional – leave empty for a link anyone can use.
team.linkHint: Send this link yourself. It is shown only now.
team.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it manually.

errors.LastTenantAdmin: Someone has to stay admin of the organization. Make another member admin first.
errors.CannotRemoveAdmin: The administrator of the installation cannot be removed here.

system.title: System
system.subtitle: Workers, how the mailboxes are distributed among them, queues and all organizations.
system.workersHint: Each worker watches a fair share of the mailboxes. Mailboxes of a worker that stops are taken over within about two minutes.
system.organizationsHint: The mailbox limit applies when a mailbox is added; existing mailboxes stay.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your profile, preferences and how you sign in.

profile.title: Profile
profile.displayNameHint: Shown in the menu and to your team instead of your email address.
profile.emailHint: You sign in with this address. It cannot be changed here.

preferences.languageHint: Applies right away and in every browser you sign in with.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: Decides the dates in folder names (such as Archive/2026/10), when scheduled rules run, and where a day starts and ends in the stats.

addresses.title: Your addresses
addresses.description: Addresses that reach you, besides the ones mailnix already knows. Rules use them to tell mail to you from other mail:

uses.onlyCc: "I am only in Cc or Bcc": none of your addresses is in To
uses.alias: "Sent to my alias": which of your addresses the mail went to
uses.reply: "Reply to my mail": answers to mail you sent

addresses.duplicate: This address is already in the list.
addresses.tooMany: You can add at most {max} addresses.
addresses.yours: All addresses that count as yours
addresses.automaticHint: Your sign-in address and the user names of your mailboxes always count.

security.passwordHint: Use at least 10 characters; a few unrelated words make a strong password. Changing it signs you out on other devices.
security.samePassword: Choose a password different from the current one.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices are signed out within a minute.
security.sessionsHint: Signed in on a computer you no longer use? Sign out everywhere except here.
security.signOutOthersConfirm: Every other browser and device that is signed in to your account is signed out within a minute. This one stays signed in.
security.othersSignedOut: Other devices are signed out within a minute.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.description: Besides your password, signing in asks for a code from an authenticator app on your phone (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or Aegis).

steps.scanHint: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
steps.verifyHint: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows now.
steps.codesHint: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe, e.g. in your password manager. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.

twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.cannotScan: Cannot scan? Enter the key by hand
twoFactor.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits the app shows.
twoFactor.invalidCode: This code is not valid. Check that the time on your phone is correct, or wait for the next code.
twoFactor.codesFileHeader: mailnix recovery codes – each code works once
twoFactor.codesLeft: No recovery codes left. | 1 recovery code left. | {count} recovery codes left.
twoFactor.codesLow: Create new ones so you do not get locked out.
twoFactor.newCodesHint: The old recovery codes stop working.
twoFactor.turnOffHint: Signing in will only need your password again. The app entry and the recovery codes stop working.

danger.title: Delete account
danger.description: Deletes your account with its mailbox connections, rules, lists and history. The mailboxes themselves and their mail stay as they are.
danger.adminCannot: You administer this installation, so your account cannot be deleted.
danger.deleteHint: This cannot be undone. Your mail stays in your mailboxes.

errors.CannotDeleteAdmin: The administrator of the installation cannot delete their account.
errors.LastTenantAdmin: You are the only admin of your organization. Make another member admin first (page Team).
